We have the following unit available at Upside Living, Business Bay studio without burj view

Link: https://www.propertyfinder.ae/en/plp/rent/apartment-for-rent-dubai-business-bay-upside-living-2PSudOeqYWO.html

September: AED 6,000
October: AED 7,500
November: AED 8,700

Each booking is for 30 nights per month, and a AED 2,000 security deposit is required.

This is currently the most affordable unit option we have available. Unfortunately, we do not have any other units below this budget.

The rates are slightly different from your requested budget. However, if these rates and the 3-month requirement work for you, please let us know. We will be happy to assist you with arranging a viewing and proceeding with the next steps.
